newsitem.title: UK: Minor Metals - Antimony drifts, bismuth steps up.
newsitem.headline: Minor Metals - Antimony drifts, bismuth steps up.

text.p: Antimony prices extended a decline over the past week, though traders said the market was close to bottoming out and could even switch direction near-term.
Elsewhere in the minor metals sector, bismuth and rhodium firmed while cobalt held steady.

Shipments from China to Europe saw antimony drift towards $2,100 a tonne in thin business, traders said. But most European traders questioned by Reuters believed prices had the potential to snap higher if support between $2,100 and $2,150 holds.
